DriveKey implements the zero-seed XXH64 algorithm from the specification in
TypeScript for bounded public archive index lookup. This notice is an excerpt;
the full specification is not reproduced. No xxHash implementation source is
incorporated. This non-cryptographic hash grants no content or chain authority.
